title: Set up the Hue bridge
subtitle: About 10 minutes

needs.label: Hue bridge and its power adapter
The Ethernet cable from the box
A free port on the router

steps.title: Connect the bridge to the router with the cable, then plug in its power.
Wait for the lights on the bridge.
steps.check: All three lights are on and steady.

steps.title: Press the big round link button on top when I ask for it.
steps.body: I’ll pair Home Assistant with the bridge. After the button you have **30 seconds**.

image.alt: The top of the Hue bridge: the round link button in the middle, three status lights at the front.

steps.title: Back in Home Assistant, name the rooms as you have them now.

fallback_text: Set up the Hue bridge (about 10 minutes). You’ll need the bridge and its adapter, the Ethernet cable from the box and a free router port. 1. Connect the bridge to the router, then plug in its power. 2. Wait until all three lights are steady (up to 2 minutes). 3. When I ask, press the round link button on top; I then have 30 seconds to pair. 4. Name the rooms in Home Assistant.
